## Manufacturer Information:
- **Enzo**: Produced in insect cells. Recombinant glycosylated catalytic domain of human TACE (ADAM17, TNF-alpha converting enzyme) cloned from human cDNA. The enzyme consists of residues Pro18-Val477, with a C-terminal His-tag.
